standard_prerequisites.use: Expresses the pullback of the cap with the first Chern class as minus the pushforward of the class along the zero section, and gives injectivity of the pullback along the bundle.

standard_prerequisites.name: The properties of a bivariant class
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, definition of a bivariant class used at proof lines 6354-6364
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the bivariant class to be moved through the flat pullback and the pushforward along the zero section, which is the displayed computation.

core_obligations: Reduce the centrality statement to the commutation statement, and set up the line bundle with its zero section, denoting the base changes along a locally finite type morphism (proof lines 6344-6353).

Compute through the bivariant axioms: using the expression of the pullback of the cap as minus the pushforward along the zero section, move the bivariant class through the flat pullback and the pushforward, obtaining that the pullback of one side equals the pullback of the other (proof lines 6354-6365).
Conclude by injectivity of the pullback along the bundle, then note that the same holds after any base change, giving the equality of bivariant classes (proof lines 6366-6370).
proof_roadmap: Reduction and setup of the line bundle (proof lines 6344-6353).
Transport through the bivariant axioms (proof lines 6354-6365).
Injectivity and base change give the class equality (proof lines 6366-6370).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the first Chern class is central in the bivariant theory and commutes with arbitrary bivariant classes (statement lines 6331-6342, tag 0B71-adjacent). The proof reduces centrality to commutation, expresses the pullback of the cap with the first Chern class through the zero section of the associated line bundle, moves the bivariant class through the flat pullback and the pushforward by the bivariant axioms, and concludes by injectivity of the pullback along the bundle. That computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
